name: Title
description: Display mission icon and title from the mission config file.

components.name: Show Logo
components.description: Dictates whether or not the logo/icon is visible in the rendered tool.

components.name: Show Title Text
components.description: Dictates whether or not the title text is visible in the rendered tool.

rows.name: Action Button
rows.description: Configure an optional action button displayed on the side of the title.

components.name: Button Text
components.description: Text to display on the action button. If empty, the button shows a default arrow icon. The button is shown whenever Button Link is set.

components.name: Button Link
components.description: An external http(s) URL (opened in a new tab); one of 'panels:show:<panelId>', 'panels:hide:<panelId>', 'plugins:show:<pluginId>', 'plugins:hide:<pluginId>' (e.g. 'panels:hide:left-panel', 'plugins:show:draw'); or a custom event name, which is emitted as-is. Event names should be namespaced (e.g. 'plugin:title:refresh'). Leave empty to hide the button.
